# Algorithm fixtures

generated-colors.png was produced with Python standard-library PNG/zlib encoding: 64×32 pixels, left half red and right half blue. generated-colors.heic was encoded from it with macOS `sips -s format heic generated-colors.png --out generated-colors.heic` on 2026-10-07. Created for this project, CC0. Neither is a garment-quality acceptance sample.
